items.title: Merged: Barge-in tuning for the Turns API
items.body: PR #318 by jarno-reson8. Turn detection now cuts off the agent mid-sentence when a caller interrupts, median cut-off 180ms. Deployed to production.

facts.text: Shipped barge-in tuning for the Turns API: agents stop within 180ms when a caller interrupts

items.title: Release v1.8.0: Frisian and Swedish are GA
items.body: Tag v1.8.0. Frisian and Swedish leave beta, bringing the API to 10 supported European languages. Mid-conversation language switching covers all 10. Closes #204.

facts.text: Release 1.8: Frisian and Swedish are generally available, taking the API to 10 European languages

items.title: Merged: Streaming decoder rewrite
items.body: PR #349. Realtime p95 latency 410ms -> 254ms (-38%) on the EU cluster, measured over a week of production traffic.

items.title: Release v1.9.0: Diarization v2
items.body: Tag v1.9.0. Speaker diarization v2: speaker count no longer has to be declared up front, and overlap handling improved. Billed at 0.2 credits per minute as before.

facts.text: Release 1.9: diarization v2 detects speaker count automatically and handles overlapping speech
